$comment: Which Spring Boot, JDK and themes go with a Vaadin release. Rules only: the
exact releases are looked up on Maven Central, and the Boot a Vaadin release
was built with is read from its published starter pom.
To change: read the release notes for the new Vaadin minor or Spring Boot
minor, add or tighten the entry, cite the URL in source, open a pull request.
A Vaadin line is `supported` when this tool has templates for it. `since`
tightens boot_min from a release onwards without splitting the line. `themes`
lists the themes the line ships, the default first.
java_max is inclusive. A weekly CI job checks this file against what Maven
Central publishes and fails, quoting source, when the two have drifted.
This copy is embedded in the binary. To override it, drop a file with the same
shape at <user config dir>/vaadin-init/compat.json or pass --compat <path>;
a line named there replaces the embedded line of the same name.
